subject: Post-demo: vendor roster, SOC 2 status & next security steps
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@medisync.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: vendor roster, SOC 2 status & next security steps

Hi Lisa —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Helpful conversation and I agree your timeline to evaluate a POC in Q4 makes sense. A quick recap and asks so we can move the security + procurement track forward: 

1) Requested artifacts
- SOC 2 report (Type II) or SOC 2 in-progress timeline and expected delivery date
- Data flow map showing where PHI (if any) is processed and stored
- Initial subprocessor list (cloud providers, analytics, monitoring, logging, backups)

2) Immediate next steps (suggested)
- You: share the initial subprocessor roster and SOC 2 status by EOD Mon (9/21) if possible
- Us: we’ll send our security questionnaire and a subprocessor template for your team to complete
- Rafael/Marissa: lead a short follow-up call week of 9/28 for any clarifying Qs

Attached: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf (security questionnaire) and a subprocessor template to make the list easy to export.

If MediSync needs a private deployment option (on-prem/VPC) to address PHI concerns we can surface pricing and timeline in parallel — let me know.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: subprocessors_template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@medisync.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: security@medisync.com
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: vendor roster, SOC 2 status & next security steps

Irene —

Appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers below and an initial CSV attached.

- SOC 2: in progress. We completed the readiness phase in July; auditing starts 10/12 and we expect Type II report by end of Q1 2027.
- PHI/data flow: we do process limited PHI in certain workflows; security@medisync.com will provide a high level flow.
- Subprocessors: attached is our current export (MediSync_Initial_Subprocessor_List.csv). It includes AWS (us-east-1), S3 backups via StorageX, NewRelic, and a few analytics vendors.

We'll review your questionnaire and try to populate the subprocessor template by Tue (9/22). If we hit any legal redlines on the questionnaire language we'll flag them on the form.

Thanks — Lisa
Lisa Grant
Head of IT Security, MediSync
[Attachment: MediSync_Initial_Subprocessor_List.csv (text/csv)]

Subject: Re: Post-demo: vendor roster, SOC 2 status & next security steps

Thanks Lisa — great signal on timelines. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- The MediSync_Initial_Subprocessor_List.csv looks fine as an export; can you confirm whether "StorageX" is a managed backup provider with access to unencrypted backups or if you use envelope encryption/KMS keys controlled by MediSync? That will affect our PSP scope.
- If you do process PHI in production flows we should set up a short technical sync (30 min) with our security engineer to go over encryption at rest, KV cache behavior, and options for private deployment. Available slots: Thu 9/24 10:00-11:00 or Tue 9/29 15:00-16:00 PT.

Marissa — can you pick this up on the technical sync once we confirm the slot?

Rafael
Director, Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the initial export, Lisa.

Rafael — thanks for the two slot options. Lisa — does Thu 9/24 10:00 PT work for a 30-min technical sync with Rafael and our security engineer (Marissa)? If yes I’ll send a calendar invite and our pre-read (short checklist) so we can use the time to confirm encryption/KMS details and the KV caching concerns that come up with inference runtimes.

I’ll also upload the questionnaire to a shared Drive folder so your security team can comment inline. Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_example (added to related_links).

Next steps summary:
- Lisa: confirm 9/24 10:00 PT or propose alternate
- MediSync Security: populate subprocessor template + flag any redlines in questionnaire by 9/22
- Redwood: provide pre-read + invite once slot confirmed

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
